ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a leaf-shape diagram with the title/caption “Figure 9-2. Leaf shapes.”, containing multiple leaf types labeled with letters. The letter B is located in the upper-right area of the image. The outline of the leaf corresponding to B is wider and rounded in the lower/base part, gradually narrows upward, and forms a relatively pointed end at the top. Reasoning: The question asks what leaf shape “leaf type B” is. Based on the shape of B in the image, it matches the characteristics of ovate, that is, like an egg, with one end wider and one end narrower. Therefore leaf type B is egg-shaped.
